title: InterBias-SV: Compound Conditions in Speaker Verification
abstract: arXiv:2609.36500v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speaker verification systems encounter combinations of noise, channel distortion, and changes in speech. Evaluating each condition separately does not establish whether their effects add. InterBias-SV organises this question around a four-term comparison: joint error, two marginal errors, and a common reference. Its results artefact contains 4,068 scored records across 17 experiments, 12 encoder labels, and six speech corpora, totalling 12 million trial evaluations. Three experiment families contain the same-corpus terms needed to compute additive contrasts. For labels assigned to speaker-trained encoders, their mean contrasts are +0.0026, +0.0088, and +0.0024 in equal error rate (EER), with larger variation across settings. These descriptive averages do not establish equivalence to additivity: trial matching, checkpoint identity, and parts of the condition metadata remain unverified. We also examine two interpretation problems. Near-c

translated_title: InterBias-SV：说话人验证中的复合条件
translated_abstract: 说话人验证系统会面临噪声、信道失真与语音变化的组合情况。若仅对每种条件分别单独评估，并不能确定其影响是否可以相加。InterBias-SV 围绕一个四项比较来组织这一问题：联合误差、两个边际误差以及一个共同参照。其结果数据集包含 4,068 条评分记录，覆盖 17 个实验、12 个编码器标签和六个语音语料库，共计 1,200 万次试验评估。其中三个实验族包含计算可加性对比所需的同语料库项。对于分配给说话人训练编码器的标签，其等错误率（EER）的平均对比值分别为 +0.0026、+0.0088 和 +0.0024，且在不同设置间波动较大。这些描述性平均值并不能确立与可加性的等价关系：试验匹配、检查点一致性以及部分条件元数据仍未得到验证。本文还考察了两个解释性问题。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出InterBias-SV基准，通过“联合误差—两个边际误差—共同参照”的四项对比量化说话人验证中噪声、信道失真与语音变化复合条件的影响，发现联合误差平均仅比单条件误差之和高出0.002~0.009的EER，但可加性尚未被严格验证。
